about: IngredientName: the ingredient's name in a line, for matching against the pantry (#46). A Japanese line is the name, a space, then the amount (amounts.json amountAfterName), so the name is the text before the last space, with its group markers, asides in brackets ('玉ねぎ(みじん切り)', 'パセリ[乾燥]') and quote marks ('「瀬戸のほんじお®」') dropped. groupMarkers: regex fragments for the marks a site puts before the names of one group of ingredients ('☆醤油', 'A牛乳', '【A】砂糖'), with no space after them, dropped from the start, repeatedly. conjunctions: text that makes the name two ingredients ('砂糖・コンソメ', '蓮根、アボカド'), so it has no name; with no spaces, they are matched anywhere in the name. leadingWords, trailingWords and cutPhrases are for spaced languages and stay empty.
